title: Costly Information Acquisition in Decentralized Markets: Experimental Evidence
eligible_reason: Laboratory market experiment. The 'difference-in-difference' is a cross-condition interaction (Low-information-cost treatment x Informed) within experimental sessions. No unit-level binary treatment that switches on at staggered calendar dates.
design_notes: Individual fixed effects appear in a panel regression of trading outcomes across trading periods (OLS, FE, RE comparison); the treatment is assigned by session, not staggered over calendar time.
screener_notes: Ineligible: lab experiment, no staggered adoption design.
